newsitem.title: USA: ARI plans reverse stock split.
newsitem.headline: ARI plans reverse stock split.

text.p: ARI Network Services Inc said Monday it plans a one-for-four reverse stock split as part of a capital restructuring plan.

The plan also includes replacement of $2 million in secured debt due December 31, 1997 with a non-voting preferred security redeemable by the company, the Internet electronic commerce services provider said.

"The preferred stock agreement is part of a three-part plan to improve the company's balance sheet," Brian Dearing, president and chief executive officer, said in a news release. "It reduces debt and interest expense without dilution while improving our overall capital structure, and underscores the continued confidence of one of our largest institutional shareholders."
The third part of the plan is the sale of new shares of common stock. The company has filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission for the registraiton of two million new shares.
